settings.title: Meet Your Instructor
Rone Cândido Lacerda

settings.editor:
For more than 11 years, Rone has studied orchid cultivation while working alongside growers and visiting orchid gardens across Brazil.
During that time he had the opportunity to observe different growing techniques used by experienced orchid producers.
Each grower had unique methods.
Different environments.
Different strategies that worked under specific conditions.
By studying these approaches and combining them with deeper research into fungi, insects, orchid biology, and plant nutrition…
Rone developed a way of teaching orchid cultivation that focuses not only on care…
But on understanding what is happening inside the plant and around it.
That knowledge is what inspired the creation of this training.

<style>
  .reveal-scroll {
    opacity: 0;
    filter: blur(14px);
    will-change: transform, opacity, filter;
    transition: none !important;
    backface-visibility: hidden;
    -webkit-backface-visibility: hidden;
    transform-style: preserve-3d;
  }

  .reveal-left {
    transform: translate3d(-80px, 0, 0);
  }

  .reveal-right {
    transform: translate3d(80px, 0, 0);
  }

  .reveal-up {
    transform: translate3d(0, 70px, 0);
  }

  .reveal-down {
    transform: translate3d(0, -70px, 0);
  }

  .reveal-soft.reveal-left {
    transform: translate3d(-45px, 0, 0);
  }

  .reveal-soft.reveal-right {
    transform: translate3d(45px, 0, 0);
  }

  .reveal-soft.reveal-up {
    transform: translate3d(0, 40px, 0);
  }

  .reveal-soft.reveal-down {
    transform: translate3d(0, -40px, 0);
  }

  @media (max-width: 767px) {
    .reveal-left {
      transform: translate3d(-28px, 0, 0);
    }

    .reveal-right {
      transform: translate3d(28px, 0, 0);
    }

    .reveal-up {
      transform: translate3d(0, 28px, 0);
    }

    .reveal-down {
      transform: translate3d(0, -28px, 0);
    }

    .reveal-scroll {
      filter: blur(8px);
    }
  }
</style>

<script>
(function () {
  function clamp(value, min, max) {
    return Math.max(min, Math.min(max, value));
  }

  function easeOutCubic(t) {
    return 1 - Math.pow(1 - t, 3);
  }

  function getDistance(el, axis) {
    const isMobile = window.innerWidth <= 767;
    const isSoft = el.classList.contains("reveal-soft");

    if (axis === "x") {
      if (isMobile) return isSoft ? 18 : 28;
      return isSoft ? 45 : 80;
    }

    if (isMobile) return isSoft ? 18 : 28;
    return isSoft ? 40 : 70;
  }

  function updateRevealElements() {
    const items = document.querySelectorAll(".reveal-scroll");
    if (!items.length) return;

    const vh = window.innerHeight || document.documentElement.clientHeight;
    const isMobile = window.innerWidth <= 767;
    const maxBlur = isMobile ? 6 : 10;

    items.forEach(function (el) {
      const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect();

      /*
        1) progresso de entrada:
        vai de 0 para 1 quando o topo do elemento sobe da parte de baixo da viewport
      */
      const enterStart = vh * 0.96;
      const enterEnd = vh * 0.38;
      let enterProgress = (enterStart - rect.top) / (enterStart - enterEnd);
      enterProgress = clamp(enterProgress, 0, 1);

      /*
        2) progresso de saída:
        vai de 1 para 0 quando o fundo do elemento vai saindo pelo topo
      */
      const exitStart = vh * 0.22;
      const exitEnd = vh * -0.18;
      let exitProgress = (rect.bottom - exitEnd) / (exitStart - exitEnd);
      exitProgress = clamp(exitProgress, 0, 1);

      /*
        progresso final:
        o elemento só fica forte enquanto está realmente na zona útil.
        entrou = aparece
        saiu = some
      */
      let progress = Math.min(enterProgress, exitProgress);
      progress = clamp(progress, 0, 1);

      const eased = easeOutCubic(progress);

      let x = 0;
      let y = 0;

      if (el.classList.contains("reveal-left")) {
        x = -getDistance(el, "x") * (1 - eased);
      }

      if (el.classList.contains("reveal-right")) {
        x = getDistance(el, "x") * (1 - eased);
      }

      if (el.classList.contains("reveal-up")) {
        y = getDistance(el, "y") * (1 - eased);
      }

      if (el.classList.contains("reveal-down")) {
        y = -getDistance(el, "y") * (1 - eased);
      }

      /*
        blur continua presente,
        mas desaparece um pouco antes da opacidade chegar no máximo
      */
      let blurFactor = 1 - (progress * 1.15);
      blurFactor = clamp(blurFactor, 0, 1);

      const opacity = eased;
      const blur = maxBlur * blurFactor;

      el.style.opacity = opacity.toFixed(3);
      el.style.filter = "blur(" + blur.toFixed(2) + "px)";
      el.style.transform = "translate3d(" + x.toFixed(2) + "px, " + y.toFixed(2) + "px, 0)";
    });
  }

  let ticking = false;

  function requestTick() {
    if (!ticking) {
      requestAnimationFrame(function () {
        updateRevealElements();
        ticking = false;
      });
      ticking = true;
    }
  }

  function initRevealScroll() {
    const items = document.querySelectorAll(".reveal-scroll");
    if (!items.length) return;

    requestTick();

    window.removeEventListener("scroll", requestTick);
    window.removeEventListener("resize", requestTick);

    window.addEventListener("scroll", requestTick, { passive: true });
    window.addEventListener("resize", requestTick);
  }

  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", initRevealScroll);
  window.addEventListener("load", initRevealScroll);
  setTimeout(initRevealScroll, 300);
  setTimeout(initRevealScroll, 900);
})();
</script>
